Sandbox_PV_MaxVehicle_tooltip: Maximum number of vehicles a player can claim.
Sandbox_PV_SupporterRoleNames_tooltip: Server roles that get the higher claim limit below, instead of the default limit. Comma-separated, example: Apoiador,VIP. The user role is ignored here.
Sandbox_PV_MaxVehicleSupporter_tooltip: Maximum number of vehicles a player with one of the Supporter Role Names can claim.
Sandbox_PV_ClaimTimeoutHours_tooltip: Hours since the player's last logout before the claim expires. Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_PV_AllowFaction_tooltip: Allow members of the owner's faction to access the vehicle.
Sandbox_PV_AllowSafehouse_tooltip: Allow members of the owner's safehouse to access the vehicle.
Sandbox_PV_TrunkParts_tooltip: Semicolon-separated list of part names treated as trunks/containers. Default: TrunkDoor;DoorRear
Sandbox_PV_CommandCooldownMs_tooltip: Minimum time between commands to prevent server lag.
Sandbox_PV_MaxRequestsPer10s_tooltip: Burst limit of requests allowed within 10 seconds.
Sandbox_PV_AdminTeleportEnabled_tooltip: Allows administrators to teleport vehicles to themselves or vice versa.
Sandbox_PV_EnablePerVehicleLogs_tooltip: Generates detailed logs for each individual vehicle.
Sandbox_PV_RequireVehicleDocumentForClai: Requires players to have a Vehicle Document item to claim a vehicle.
Sandbox_PV_VehicleDocumentItemType_toolt: Full item type name of the required document (default: Base.VehicleDocument).
Sandbox_PV_ConsumeVehicleDocumentOnClaim: If enabled, the document is removed from inventory upon claiming.
Sandbox_PV_ReturnDocumentOnUnclaim_toolt: If enabled, the consumed document is returned to the player when they unclaim the vehicle.
Sandbox_PV_EnableCoordSyncLogs_tooltip: Log vehicle coordinate updates (COORD_SYNC) to file. Disabled by default to avoid log spam. Does not echo to console.
Sandbox_PV_EnableVerboseConsoleLogs_tool: Echo all non-critical log events (vehicle events, allow-list changes) to the server console. Disable to keep the console clean.
Sandbox_PV_RequireConversionDocument_too: If enabled, the player must have a blank Vehicle Title in their inventory to convert a vehicle.
Sandbox_PV_RequireKeyForConversion_toolt: If enabled, conversion requires that the vehicle currently has a usable key state. With hotwire allowed, hotwired vehicles also pass.
Sandbox_PV_AllowHotwiredForConversion_to: When key requirement is enabled, allows hotwired vehicles to be converted even if no key is present.
Sandbox_PV_MaxVehicleDocuments_tooltip: Maximum number of Vehicle Titles a player can hold at once. Set to 0 for unlimited.
Sandbox_PV_DocumentValidityHours_tooltip: How long a Vehicle Title remains valid after conversion, in hours. Set to 0 so titles never expire.
Sandbox_PV_MinVehicleConditionForConvers: Blocks conversion when the vehicle's overall condition is below this value. Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_PV_ConsumeDocumentOnSpawn_toolti: If enabled, the Vehicle Title is removed from inventory after spawning the vehicle.
Sandbox_PV_SpawnMaxDistance_tooltip: Maximum distance in tiles from the player where a vehicle can be spawned from a title.
Sandbox_PV_AllowShopTransfer_tooltip: Allow Vehicle Titles to be listed and sold via the Survivor Shop marketplace.
